displayName: Football Supabase backup missing for 27 hours

documentation.subject: Football backup missing - action needed
documentation.content: No successful write to the dedicated football database backup bucket for 27 hours. Check fcp-supabase-backup on VM fcp-workers-1, inspect its recent logs and /var/lib/fcp/backups/last-success.json, then confirm a new Google Cloud Storage object exists. This alert does not include database contents. A normal backup runs at 03:00 UTC daily.

conditions.displayName: No successful backup-bucket write in 27 hours
